newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Police, rioters clash in Albanian port.
newsitem.headline: Police, rioters clash in Albanian port.

text.p: Thousands of demonstrators went on a rampage against riot police in the Albanian port of Vlore on Monday, hurling stones and furniture and cornering officers against buildings.

The rioting engulfed streets around Independence Square where tens of thousands of protesters denouncing President Sali Berisha and the collapse of pyramid investment schemes had marched peacefully on five successive days.

Elderly men and women picked up paving stones and handed them to demonstrators who threw them at police forced to retreat in small groups up a hill. Several people were seen carried from the city centre, blood streaming from their faces.

A group of police hemmed in next to a buiding had been stripped to their underpants. Rioters burned their clothes along with captured riot shields to loud cheers and three plumes of black smoke rose from the area.

There was no indication of casualties. On Sunday night, when clashes broke out in the evening, one protester died after demonstrators had pelted a police station with stones and security forces responded by firing into the air.
